officialSites.name: Municipio de David
officialSites.note: Domain no longer resolves (checked 2026-08-22). Panamanian provincial/district governments have largely moved their public presence to social media; the live national municipal portal is AMUPA (https://amupa.org.pa/) and city services for the capital are at MUPA (https://mupa.gob.pa/). Entry kept for reference.
